headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch

writeup.headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Alphabet's Anthropic Stake Becomes the Market's Biggest Mover. The big swing: chip and AI stocks rallied early, then turned around after 9:49 AM and are now lower on the day — 조선일보 points to “New York Stock Market Reverses Gains Amid Rising Oil Prices, Yields”. The AI names are down and the average stock is down: stocks are moving together. Defensive sectors are leading cyclical ones, and the S&P has stayed under pressure.

themes.headline: Chip and AI stocks flipped from up to down
themes.detail: Up 4.4% at 9:49 AM, now -0.6%; hardest hit since: Advanced Micro Devices, Oracle. In the news: “New York Stock Market Reverses Gains Amid Rising Oil Prices, Yields” (조선일보).

themes.headline: S&P has stayed under pressure
themes.detail: Low at 11:59 AM, high at 9:50 AM; -1.8% since the open.

themes.headline: Alphabet's Anthropic Stake Becomes the Market's Biggest Mover
themes.detail: Alphabet +0.9%, Palo Alto Networks +4.7% on the day.

themes.headline: Cons. Staples leads, Technology lags
themes.detail: Since the open: Cons. Staples -0.5%, Technology -2.5%.
